messages:
harry: quick repro in the node onboarding sample: x-request-id present on first send but missing or <redacted> on retry. repo: https://git.internal/samples/telemetry-retry-node :wave:

harry: minimal logs from local run:

```
INFO 2026-05-01T10:00:00Z outgoing.request method=POST path=/v1/infer headers={"x-request-id":"rid-abc123"}
ERROR 2026-05-01T10:00:00Z upstream.status code=502 body=... will retry
DEBUG 2026-05-01T10:00:00Z retry.builder attempt=1 cloning request
INFO 2026-05-01T10:00:00Z outgoing.request method=POST path=/v1/infer headers={"x-request-id":"<redacted>"}
```

kevin: my hunch is redaction runs before the OTEL propagator on the retry path, so the propagator never sees the header when reconstructing the retry. span/trace ids still export correctly.

emily: two safe approaches: (A) defer header redaction until emission (env RW_REDACT_PHASE=emit) so runtime context stays intact, or (B) capture req id into a typed context key and span attribute on first parse and have retry-builder prefer ctx/span when rehydrating headers.

kevin: i'll prototype (B) as a small PoC: on incoming request if header present -> ctx = ctx.withValue(reqIdKey, rid); span.setAttribute('rw.reqid', rid). retry-builder will use ctx.Value(reqIdKey) || headers['x-request-id'] when building the retry. will add unit tests.

emily: please add RW_EXPORT_REQID=true/false guard so teams can opt out of exporting identifiers to traces (rw_export_reqid env). also ensure logging emission still respects RW_REDACT_* settings so we don't leak PII.

harry: good. can we also add a tiny CI job that runs the sample with RW_REDACT_PHASE={inline,emit} and asserts reqid is preserved for retries (in internal ctx/span) and exported conditionally?

qa-bot: created ticket DEVEX-3509 "reqid redacted on retry in node sample" and added CI matrix task (owner: qa-team).

ops-bot: preview deployed: https://preview.internal/repro/reqid-3509 (sha: a1b2c3).

harry: action items:
- kevin: PoC + PR to set typed ctx key and span attr (owner: kevin)
- emily: add RW_EXPORT_REQID toggles and doc blurb for onboarding (owner: emily)
- qa-team: add small e2e/CI matrix to catch regressions (owner: qa-team)

harry: target: land quick fix this sprint, follow-up to consider middleware ordering changes across SDKs. :thumbsup:
